title: Validation Service — Implementer Adoption
description: Who uses the Validation Service, which IFC schemas and functional parts (alignment!) their tools actually produce, and which MVDs they declare. Built for the Implementers Assembly.

panels.title: Companies
panels.description: Companies detected from the authoring tool in uploaded files. 'in range' = with at least one upload in the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id) FROM ifc_model m
        JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_company) AS "all-time"

panels.title: Tools
panels.description: Distinct authoring tools by name stem (name up to the first digit: 'Revit 26.4 (ENU)' -> 'Revit'). The raw name field carries version and language package, so raw distinct names over-count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(at.name, '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)')) FROM ifc_model m
        JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(at.name, '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)')) FROM ifc_authoring_tool at) AS "all-time"

panels.title: Tool versions
panels.description: Distinct authoring tool rows (name + version as written in the file header).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.produced_by_id) FROM ifc_model m WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_authoring_tool) AS "all-time"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_model m WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_model) AS "all-time"

panels.title: Schema adoption per month
panels.description: Uploaded models per month by schema family. The raw schema field is normalised (IFC4X3_ADD2, IFC4X3, 'IFC 4.3 ADD2' ... -> IFC4X3); '(empty)' = no schema in the header.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', created) AS time, upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(schema, ''), ' ', ''), '_', '')) AS raw
           FROM ifc_model WHERE $__timeFilter(created))
SELECT time, CASE WHEN raw ~ 'IFC4X3|IFC4\.3' THEN 'IFC4X3' WHEN raw ~ 'IFC4X[12]' THEN 'IFC4X1/4X2' WHEN raw ~ '^IFC4' THEN 'IFC4' WHEN raw ~ 'IFC2X3|^2X3' THEN 'IFC2X3' WHEN raw = '' THEN '(empty)' ELSE 'other' END AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value
FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Who produces IFC 4.3: distinct tools and companies per month
panels.description: Tools (name stem) and companies with at least one IFC4X3 upload in that month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', m.created) AS time, 'tools' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(at.name, '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)'))::float AS value
FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(m.schema, ''), ' ', ''), '_', '')) ~ 'IFC4X3|IFC4\.3' GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT date_trunc('month', m.created) AS time, 'companies' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id)::float AS value
FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(m.schema, ''), ' ', ''), '_', '')) ~ 'IFC4X3|IFC4\.3' GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Capability: functional parts produced, by distinct tools and companies
panels.description: Which parts of IFC do tools actually produce. A functional part counts for a tool when at least one of its rules ACTIVATED (outcome severity other than N/A - a failed rule still proves the tool writes that part). Lower bound: a rule only activates when its precondition is met. Source: vs_adoption_capability, refreshed nightly by `manage.py refresh_adoption_metrics` (the outcomes table is too large to aggregate live over a year). Tools are name stems; model-months = a model counts once per month it was validated in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT functional_part AS "functional part",
       COUNT(DISTINCT tool_stem)  AS tools,
       COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS companies,
       SUM(models)                AS "model-months"
FROM vs_adoption_capability
WHERE $__timeFilter(month)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC

panels.title: Alignment (ALA/ALB/ALS) per month: distinct tools and companies
panels.description: Tools and companies whose uploads activated at least one alignment rule that month. Same source and caveats as the capability table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT month::timestamptz AS time, 'tools' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT tool_stem)::float AS value
FROM vs_adoption_capability WHERE functional_part LIKE 'AL_' AND $__timeFilter(month) GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT month::timestamptz AS time, 'companies' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT company_id)::float AS value
FROM vs_adoption_capability WHERE functional_part LIKE 'AL_' AND $__timeFilter(month) GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: MVD declared per tool (top 20)
panels.description: Model View Definition as declared in the file header, per tool name stem.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(at.name, '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)') AS tool, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.mvd, ''), '(none)') AS mvd, COUNT(*) AS models
FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Capability, last 2 months - LIVE (slow, ~15 s; ignores time picker)
panels.description: Same as the capability table above but computed live from the outcomes table over the last 2 months. Works without the nightly job; expect 10-20 s cold.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT min(id) AS tid FROM ifc_validation_task WHERE created >= now() - interval '2 months')
SELECT left(vo.feature, 3)          AS "functional part",
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.id)         AS models,
       COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(at.name, '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)'))       AS tools,
       COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id) AS companies
FROM ifc_validation_outcome vo
JOIN ifc_validation_task    vt ON vt.id = vo.validation_task_id
JOIN ifc_validation_request vr ON vr.id = vt.request_id
JOIN ifc_model              m  ON m.id  = vr.model_id
LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE vo.validation_task_id >= (SELECT tid FROM w)
  AND vo.severity > 0 AND vo.feature ~ '^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{3}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 4 DESC

panels.title: Alignment per month - LIVE (slow, ~10 s)
panels.description: Tools and companies with an activated ALA/ALB rule per month, computed live. Uses a prefix range on the feature index; fine for a couple of years.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', vo.created) AS time, 'tools' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(at.name, '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)'))::float AS value
FROM ifc_validation_outcome vo
JOIN ifc_validation_task    vt ON vt.id = vo.validation_task_id
JOIN ifc_validation_request vr ON vr.id = vt.request_id
JOIN ifc_model              m  ON m.id  = vr.model_id
LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE vo.feature >= 'ALA' AND vo.feature < 'ALC' AND vo.severity > 0 AND $__timeFilter(vo.created)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT date_trunc('month', vo.created) AS time, 'companies' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id)::float AS value
FROM ifc_validation_outcome vo
JOIN ifc_validation_task    vt ON vt.id = vo.validation_task_id
JOIN ifc_validation_request vr ON vr.id = vt.request_id
JOIN ifc_model              m  ON m.id  = vr.model_id
LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE vo.feature >= 'ALA' AND vo.feature < 'ALC' AND vo.severity > 0 AND $__timeFilter(vo.created)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2
